name: Frigorific-Vortex
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a binary sunset, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
There is money in exotic matter here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
